derivation_statement: CopperMCP Contributors independently authored this synthetic routing topology. It uses only high-level pin-role and bypass-placement facts from TI's public NE5532x datasheet; it copies no schematic, PCB, artwork, value selection, BOM, or design text from a third party.

source_material.title: TI NE5532x, SA5532x Dual Low-Noise Operational Amplifiers (SLOS075K, Rev. K)
source_material.used_for: The public pin-function table identifies the dual-amplifier input/output and VCC+/VCC- roles; the layout guidance recommends placing 0.1-uF bypass capacitors close to supply pins.

source_material.title: KiCad board S-expression file format documentation
source_material.used_for: The fixture is stored as a native KiCad PCB S-expression rather than an external board download.
